method: Eight distinct user-flow checks, each executed in installed Google Chrome at desktop and mobile-emulated viewports. Native CDP touch input is used for mobile pointer drags. Passive observation of real Worker responses; no fake landmark/mask results. Cancellation delays a real local model fetch; the recovery check returns one intentional HTTP503 then allows genuine model bytes.
scope: One real licensed subject/scene. Procedural blank image/video are explicitly negative controls. No accuracy benchmark, physical-phone, Safari or GPU execution claim. Reset stability is checked after pausing; no deterministic in-flight reset-response scheduling is claimed.

geometry_checks.scope: Geometry and mask data operations; no pose-model accuracy benchmark.
